question: What is the higher significance attributed to the constant washing of the mouth?
premises: Washing the mouth is to be done always.
This act is described as going upward to Brahman.
The teaching is addressed to the beloved.
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is identified as rising upward to Brahman.
uncertainties: The ritual or symbolic meaning of this washing is context-dependent.
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is that which has gone upward to Brahman.
